narrative:
Washington County has 41,296 registered voters, with 55.7% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 31.1% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 13.2%, a pronounced Republican lean of 17.9 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 30.4% of registrants.
